purpose: Document first-party Colombian and Tunja cadastral discovery and bounded anonymous service review.
assessment: Tunja's municipal cadastral custody and current public geovisor/backend were evidenced. Public bootstrap and municipality metadata worked anonymously, but LADM-COL parcel configuration and parcel/terrain consultation returned HTTP 401 without a session. No parcel polygon was retained and runtime remains held.
registryAssessment: registryFound=true is supported by the official Catastro Tunja portal and its statement that the municipal cadastral administration is the gestor catastral enabled by IGAC. This evidences local cadastral service custody, not a qualified open parcel adapter.
